----- usos-users.cmd -----
@echo off
rem USOS: local administrator accounts from usos-xp.ini, run hidden by pae.exe at setup end.
set USOS_LOG=%SystemRoot%\usos-users.log
net user "Tester" "Test123!" /add >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
for %%G in (Administrators Administratorzy Administratoren Administrateurs Administradores Administratori) do net localgroup %%G "Tester" /add >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer" /v NoDriveTypeAutoRun /t REG_DWORD /d 255 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
rem USOS profile: Explorer settings for new users (Default User hive).
set USOS_PD=
set USOS_DU=
for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v ProfilesDirectory 2^>nul') do if /i "%%A"=="REG_EXPAND_SZ" call set "USOS_PD=%%B"
for /f "tokens=2*" %%A in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList" /v DefaultUserProfile 2^>nul') do if /i "%%A"=="REG_SZ" set "USOS_DU=%%B"
if not defined USOS_PD set "USOS_PD=%SystemDrive%\Documents and Settings"
if not defined USOS_DU set "USOS_DU=Default User"
reg load HKU\USOSDEF "%USOS_PD%\%USOS_DU%\NTUSER.DAT" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v HideFileExt /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
reg add "HKU\USOSDEF\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v Hidden /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
reg unload HKU\USOSDEF >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
powercfg.exe /hibernate off >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
net.exe accounts /maxpwage:unlimited >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
"%~dp0usos-reg.exe" --log "%SystemRoot%\usos-reg.log" "%~dp0usos-reg.txt" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
del /f /q "%~dp0usos-reg.txt" >> "%USOS_LOG%" 2>&1
exit /b 0
